title: The Last Tickets
content:
Anna and Lucas had been waiting for months for their favorite band to announce a concert in their city. When the date was finally announced, they decided to buy their tickets immediately.

On Friday morning, Anna was checking the ticket website while Lucas was on his way to work.

— The tickets are on sale now! — Anna wrote.

— Already? I'm almost at work. Can you buy two for us?

— I can try, but there are already thousands of people on the website.

Anna entered the virtual waiting room and watched the number on her screen slowly change.

After twenty minutes, she finally reached the ticket page.

— I'm in!

— Great! How much are they?

— There are different sections. The cheapest tickets are almost sold out.

— Buy two before we lose them!

Anna selected two tickets and entered her payment information. Suddenly, the website showed an error.

— Oh no!

— What happened?

— The payment didn't go through.

— Try again!

Anna tried again, but the website stopped responding.

— This is terrible. I think we lost the tickets.

A few minutes later, the website started working again. Anna checked the available seats.

— There are only two tickets left!

— Buy them!

— They're much more expensive than the ones we chose before.

Lucas thought for a moment.

— It's our favorite band. We can save money next month.

Anna laughed.

— Okay. I'm buying them.

This time, the payment was successful.

— We got them!

— Really?

— Yes! Two tickets!

Lucas was extremely happy.

— This is going to be an amazing night.

Over the next few weeks, they planned everything. They chose what to wear, decided how they would get to the venue, and even learned the songs they didn't know very well.

Finally, the day of the concert arrived.

When they reached the venue, a long line had already formed outside.

— Look at all these people! — Anna said.

— I'm glad we bought the tickets early.

After waiting for almost an hour, they entered the venue. The lights were already flashing, and music was playing loudly.

— Our seats are over there — Lucas said, pointing toward the stage.

They found their places just a few minutes before the show began.

The lights suddenly went out.

The crowd screamed.

Then the first notes of their favorite song filled the stadium.

Anna looked at Lucas and smiled.

— It was worth every penny.

— I completely agree.

They spent the entire evening singing, dancing, and enjoying the show.

On the way home, Lucas looked at the tickets on his phone.

— We should keep these.

— Why?

— So we'll remember the night we almost lost them.

Anna laughed.

— Next time, we'll buy them even faster!
